request.query: A ring homomorphism annihilating a polynomial divisor maps polynomials with equal monic division remainders to the same value

items.name: Polynomial.map_mod
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {k : Type y} [inst : Field R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Field k] (f : R →+* k),
  Polynomial.map f (p % q) = Polynomial.map f p % Polynomial.map f q

items.name: Polynomial.map_modByMonic
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Ring S] (f : R →+* S),
  q.Monic → Polynomial.map f (p %ₘ q) = Polynomial.map f p %ₘ Polynomial.map f q

items.name: IsAdjoinRootMonic.map_modByMonic
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] {f : Polynomial R} [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (h : IsAdjoinRootMonic S f) (g : Polynomial R), h.map (g %ₘ f) = h.map g

items.name: Polynomial.map_divByMonic
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Ring S] (f : R →+* S),
  q.Monic → Polynomial.map f (p /ₘ q) = Polynomial.map f p /ₘ Polynomial.map f q

items.name: AdjoinRoot.mapAlgHom
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {S : Type u_2} →
    {T : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommRing R] →
        [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
          [inst_2 : CommRing T] →
            [inst_3 : Algebra R S] →
              [inst_4 : Algebra R T] →
                (f : S →ₐ[R] T) →
                  (p : Polynomial S) → (q : Polynomial T) → q ∣ Polynomial.map (↑f) p → AdjoinRoot p →ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot q

items.name: IsAdjoinRootMonic.modByMonicHom_map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] {f : Polynomial R} [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (h : IsAdjoinRootMonic S f) (g : Polynomial R), h.modByMonicHom (h.map g) = g %ₘ f
